children: NextDC's bull at UBS sees only limited risks around the debt supported by the data-center operator's convertible notes. Analyst Tim Plumbe acknowledges that investors aren't wrong to wonder what might happens if the notes need to be redeemed at a time when interest rates are high and banks don't want to lend. However, he writes in a note that the risk is low and that current worries around debt and capex represent a small wobble in a longer-term structural story of cloud and AI growth. Plumbe doesn't think NextDC will have to sell land assets. UBS has a buy rating on the stock and a target price of 18.50 Australian dollars. Shares are up 0.2% at A$6.39. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
